section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the results of Experiment 1, which explored the relationship between divergent thinking and attentional flexibility, suggesting cognitive control as a potential mechanism. It then introduces Experiment 2, described as a larger-scale replication of Experiment 1, which also investigated the link between cognitive control and real-life creative achievement. Experiment 2 utilized the WASI (Wechsler, 1999) to measure general intelligence as a covariate.
